sloka: आरुह्य पुष्पकं दिव्यं विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम् ।उत्तरां दिशमालोक्य जगाम पुरुषोत्तमः ।। ५.२७.१९।।।।
transliteration: āruhya puṣpakaṁ divyaṁ vimānaṁ sūryasannibham ।uttarāṁ diśamālokya jagāma puruṣottamaḥ ।। 5.27.19।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant Rama, foremost among men, accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and wife Sita went towards the northerly direction in the wonderful Pushpaka chariot that resembled the Sun.
